The following is a source inventory at snapy `e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0`, not a run log. No
compiled snapy test was run for this draft; every tolerance below is read from the test source, and every measured
value is missing evidence until a pinned build runs the entry. `<b>` is the build suffix, normally `release`. The
report's own CPU checks are listed last. "CUDA case" means the test fixture also runs on CUDA, in float32
and float64, and skips that case at run time without a device; "if built" means the CUDA case exists only in CUDA
builds. The checks verify formulas ported from the code and import no snapy.

### Saturation adjustment and redo

| ctest | asserts | tolerance | device, ranks |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_wall_saturation.<b>` | energy and water at a wall, condensing and evaporating | $10^{-12}$ rel. | CPU; CUDA if built |
| `test_balance_column.<b>` (moist case) | moist column at rest; condensate stays 0 | $10^{-10}$; $10^{-12}$ | CPU |
| `test_vic_moist_device_python` | CPU and CUDA agree after one step | $10^{-9}$ | CUDA builds only |
| `test_check_redo_saturation_python` | saturation cause alone; drained; Mesh arm | logical | CPU |
| `test_check_redo_saturation_cuda_python` | the same on CUDA | logical | CUDA builds only |
| `test_check_redo_parallel.<b>` | one decision across ranks | exact | 2 ranks |
| `test_check_redo_floor_python` | floor and NaN causes, Mesh arm | logical | CPU |
| `test_forcing.<b>` (limiter cases) | species repair redoes; round-off does not | ulp bound | CPU |
| `test_uranus_cycle1_abort.<b>` | Uranus column through `run_hydro` | exit status | CPU |

: Evidence for @sec-ch10-satadj, @sec-ch10-redo and @sec-ch10-kinetics. {#tbl-ch15-ch10-satadj}

The wall test is registered once ([`CMakeLists.txt:117`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/tests/CMakeLists.txt#L117), `test_wall_saturation`);
the moist balance case runs in `test_balance_column` and in its `_wb_ref4` and `_x1_centroid` arms
([`CMakeLists.txt:96-101`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/tests/CMakeLists.txt#L96-L101), `test_balance_column`).
The CUDA arms are registered only in CUDA builds
([`CMakeLists.txt:283-285`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/tests/CMakeLists.txt#L283-L285), `test_check_redo_saturation_cuda`).
The moist balance numbers in the moist balance-column team note under `sources/team-notes/` were measured at
snapy@fc3534c34dc514805b80ba3ac75bf14b80dd4e12, before the pin, and are not used as evidence here.

The Gloo arm of the seam test compares against the UCX result through `run_seam_backends.py`
([`CMakeLists.txt:132-141`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/tests/CMakeLists.txt#L132-L141), `test_sedimentation_cubed_seam_gloo`).

### Gaps and the report's own checks

No snapy test covers one kinetics step's mass and energy budget, the evaporation rate, or the
`jupiter_evap_precip_1d` driver; no test runs the saturation adjustment on more than one rank or across a decomposed
reflecting wall ([chengcli/snapy#208](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/issues/208)); the MPS sedimentation path is
untested; and the switch coverage matrix (@sec-ch12-matrix) has no moist rows.

Run `python3 src/snapy_report/ch10/<scheme>_check.py` for `fixvapor`, `borrow`, `kinetics`, `tracer`, `sed` and
`redo`; each prints labelled `[Cn]` lines and exits with its number of failed claims, and the sibling `.out` file is
its committed output. `src/tests/test_ch10_checks.py` requires every output to be current. These checks run on CPU
in float64 (and float32 where stated) and verify ported formulas, not compiled behaviour.
